==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Assertions&min=Assertions&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/AssertionsTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Assertions&min=Assertions&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
// Verify.Assertions: Runs assertions against objects as they are serialized, so a value nested in a large graph can be checked mid-verification.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Assertions
// Note: VerifyAssertions.Assert<T>(...) in the module initializer applies an assertion to every
// verification in the project.
// Note: An assertion for a type that is never serialized never runs and never fails, so a wrong
// type argument passes silently.
// Note: The package is pre 1.0, so its api can still change.
public class AssertionsTests
{
    // The callback runs while the graph is serialized, so a value buried in it is asserted on
    // without being dug out first, and the snapshot still covers everything else.
    // Any assertion library works here; a BCL throw helper keeps the sample independent of the
    // test framework.
    [Fact]
    public Task AssertNested()
    {
        var person = ClassBeingTested.FindPerson();
        return Verify(person)
            .Assert<Address>(_ => ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(_.Country));
    }
}
